annotations.title: Add a view to a sheet table

description: Adds a saved view everyone sees: a grid (with where / sort), a board (lanes from a select or person column — groupBy), or a form people fill in to add records (formFields, formTitle, formIntro). A form's share link is made from the sheet's form view.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

groupBy.description: Board: the select or person column whose values are the lanes.

table.description: The table tab's name or id.

op.description: is (default), is_not, contains, not_contains, gt, gte, lt, lte, empty, not_empty, any_of, none_of, checked, unchecked

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this.

name: napkin_tables_add_view
title: Add a view to a sheet table
